issue.title: test_mutation_completion_after_unmount_invalidates_memo sees an extra catalog load under Master Gate
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_cached_open.py::test_mutation_completion_after_unmount_invalidates_memo`
- **Repro:** Master Gate sharded `just test` (shard 7/8, 3 xdist workers)

Master Gate run 37992380866 on tip 7c6039f1e68483cbc1a206e7745a32830c4429db failed only this node in job test (7): AssertionError assert 3 == 2 on `len(calls)` after reopen. The rest of that shard was 6780 passed, 12 skipped. Lint and the other seven test shards succeeded. On the same tip, the node passed 7/7 in isolation (`.venv/bin/python -m pytest` of that node id). No commit between the last green Master Gate (73c128074d, run 37972110667) and this tip touches this test or the plugins-browser pane sources. Fail rate: 1 CI shard failure, 0/7 local isolation. The extra catalog call is consistent with `_handle_code_update_completion` still seeing `is_mounted` and calling `_start_load` before the popped pane finishes unmounting, but that race was not reproduced locally.
